headline: Philippines Beats Kuwait 2-1 for First Asian Games Men’s Football Win in 68 Years
seoTitle: Philippines Beats Kuwait for First Asian Games Football Win Since 1958 | FMB News
seoDescription: The Philippine U23 men’s football team defeated Kuwait 2-1 in Nagoya, its first Asian Games men’s football victory since the 1958 Tokyo Games.
deck: Santi Rublico opened the scoring and Andres Aldeguer converted a stoppage-time penalty as the Philippines ended a 68-year wait for an Asian Games men’s football victory, although the team had already been eliminated from quarterfinal contention.
author: FMB News Sports Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: The Philippine Under-23 men’s national football team defeated Kuwait 2-1 on September 22 at CS Asset Minato Soccer Stadium in Nagoya, closing its 2026 Asian Games campaign with the country’s first men’s football win at the Games since 1958.

Santi Rublico put the Philippines ahead in the 19th minute. Kuwait equalized in the 66th minute when a cross was turned into the Philippine goal by defender Scott Woods. Substitute Jax Peña was then fouled inside the penalty area in stoppage time, and Andres Aldeguer converted the resulting penalty in the 92nd minute.

sections.heading: What is confirmed
paragraphs: The Philippine Football Federation’s official report confirms the 2-1 score, the scorers and the historical milestone. GMA News, the Philippine Daily Inquirer and ABS-CBN News independently reported the same result and milestone.

PFF says the previous Philippine Asian Games men’s football victory came at the 1958 Tokyo Games against host Japan. The Philippines did not participate in the Asian Games men’s football tournament after 1974 until its 2026 return.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The Philippines had already been eliminated from quarterfinal contention before facing Kuwait. It finished Group C in third place with one win and two losses, after defeats to Uzbekistan and Vietnam. The result is therefore a historical milestone, not a qualification result.

sections.heading: A family connection
paragraphs: PFF noted that Andres Aldeguer’s stoppage-time winner came 68 years after his great-grandfather George Aldeguer scored the winning goal in the Philippines’ 1-0 victory over Japan at the 1958 Asian Games.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: The victory ends one of the longest gaps between Philippine wins in a major continental team-sport competition and gives the returning U23 program a tangible result after more than five decades away from Asian Games men’s football.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: The Philippines’ 2026 Asian Games group-stage campaign is complete. Watch the Philippine Football Federation for the U23 team’s next official fixtures, roster plans and competition schedule.

verificationNotes: The Philippine Football Federation’s official report confirms the 2-1 result, the sequence of goals, the third-place Group C finish and the first Asian Games men’s football win since 1958.
GMA News, Inquirer and ABS-CBN independently corroborate the completed result and historical milestone.
The article explicitly states that the Philippines had already been eliminated and does not imply the victory produced quarterfinal qualification.
The historical 1958 comparison is attributed to PFF and independently repeated by major Philippine news organizations.
